items.title: Will bulls stay in control during Muhurat trading? Experts decode outlook
items.description: Data shows that the Sensex and Nifty 50 have gained in eight of the 10 Muhurat trading sessions between 2016 and 2025.

items.title: Muhurat trading: D-St to open for special session on Diwali; check timings
items.description: Muhurat trading time: BSE and NSE will hold Muhurat trading from 2:20 PM to 3:30 PM. A 15-minute pre-opening session will take place from 2:05 PM to 2:20 PM.
